data.name: Giant Beast Island
data.detailed_description:
This is an incredibly engaging dinosaur-themed survival adventure game. Players will take on the role of a newly hatched dinosaur, landing on a mysterious Jurassic island filled with unknown dangers and diverse dinosaur species. You must struggle to survive in this perilous wilderness, gradually uncovering the island's hidden secrets.

Team & Territory
To enhance survival chances on this dangerous island, joining a team is the optimal choice. Each team has its own exclusive territory where you can safely nurture and grow your dinosaur companions.

Movement Controls
The game supports classic WASD keys for dinosaur movement. Pressing Shift + WASD activates sprint mode, allowing rapid traversal across the island's terrain.

Combat & Attacks
Attacks are executed via mouse controls: left-click for standard attacks. Certain dinosaurs possess dual attack systems, with secondary attacks triggered by the right mouse button. When battling different dinosaur species, adapt tactics flexibly—combining attack styles, positioning techniques, and terrain advantages to deliver effective counterattacks and hunts.

Stamina System
Running, jumping, and executing special attacks consume the dinosaur's stamina. When stamina is depleted, these actions become unavailable until natural recovery occurs.

Growth & Evolution
Contains multiple species of dinosaurs, consuming meat, and drinking water. Once experience reaches its maximum, the dinosaur undergoes evolutionary transformation, unlocking enhanced abilities.

Diverse Dinosaur Species
The game features over thirty distinct dinosaur species, each with unique traits and combat styles. Tactical preparation tailored to specific opponents is essential for hunting or combat.

Additional Core Mechanics
Press the H key to toggle between "Rest" and "Active" states. In Rest mode, stamina recovery accelerates significantly. While focused on actions like eating meat, remain vigilant—other dinosaurs on the island may launch sudden attacks at any moment. Danger is omnipresent.

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super
